summary: Tested Product Editor Phase 2 (Spesifikasi & Pengiriman) and re-checked 3 phase-1 bugs. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass (11 new in test_pgs_iter24_specs_shipping.py plus 19 in iter23 after adding weight_grams to the base form). Covered: publish returns 422 for weight_grams=0, partial dimensions, both shipping types off, and preorder_days 0 or 91; specs keep only allowed keys and drop empty ones; product and editor APIs return specs, weight, L/W/H, preorder, preorder_days and processing_days; context.shipping has origin, pickup and couriers (no pickup, each with a cargo flag); a product limited to couriers ['jne'] gets only pickup + jne from /shipping/rates; using a temporary 'Indah Cargo' courier on acct1's store (restored afterwards), a cargo-only product shows the cargo courier with no regular couriers, and adding a regular-only product hides both. All 3 bugs are FIXED: (1) a product set inactive leaves GET /cart and checkout returns 400; (2) cart-variant-{key} has text-decoration none; (3) the pgs-9955 editor API and UI show Dapur / Peralatan Masak. Frontend at 390px: pe-specs fields change with category (fashion: material/color/size/origin/extra; audio-elektronik: color/dimensions/weight/origin/warranty/extra; dapur: all). pe-spec-dimensions and pe-spec-weight fill in automatically and are read-only. pe-volumetric shows when volume weight is bigger than actual weight. Courier pills jne/jnt/sicepat show; pe-ship-cargo is disabled (no cargo courier at pgs-official). The pre-order toggle shows pe-preorder-days (default 7) and hides pe-processing-days. Completeness lists 'Berat produk'. Turning off regular shipping shows pe-shipping-error. Publishing from a draft works through confirm and success to /product/{id}, where pd-specs, pd-preorder and pd-processing all show. Billable volumetric weight with live RajaOngkir was not tested: the code was reviewed only and the formula L*W*H/6 grams is correct.

minor.issue: Validation only checks the ship_regular/ship_cargo flags. Publishing with ship_regular=false and ship_cargo=true is accepted even when the store has no cargo courier, so buyers can only use pickup. The UI disables the switch, but the API does not check it.
The 'couriers' list is not checked against the store's courier codes. Unknown codes are accepted, and an unknown-only list leaves pickup as the only option.
preorder_days and processing_days only appear on the product page. Cart, checkout ETA and order data ignore them, so a buyer of a 30-day pre-order still sees the courier ETA only.

issues: On web, the RN Switch thumbs (pe-ship-regular, pe-preorder) are the default teal on the orange brandPrimary track. Set thumbColor/activeThumbColor to match the brand.
pe-origin shows 'Belum diatur...' for pgs-official because no origin is set in Pengaturan Ongkir and the store has no address. This is data, not code.
Pre-order products still show the static 'Pengiriman cepat dari Sidoarjo' perk under the pre-order notice, which contradicts it.

action_items: Optional: in validate(), reject ship_cargo=true (when ship_regular=false) if the target store has no active cargo courier.
Optional: filter or validate form.couriers against the store's courier codes.
Optional: add preorder_days/processing_days to the checkout ETA (and the order item), and hide the 'Pengiriman cepat' perk for pre-order products.
Optional: set Switch thumbColor/activeThumbColor to match the brand.
critical_code_review_comments: Imported products have no weight_grams, so editing any of them now needs a weight before saving (completeness shows 'Berat produk' unchecked). This is expected, but worth telling sellers.
If a product has an explicit couriers list, a cargo courier added to the store later is not included automatically. Only couriers=[] means all.

specKeysFor() matches regexes on the category and subcategory names. A substring like 'tas' or 'mesin' in a subcategory can switch the field set (fashion is checked before elektronik). This is acceptable but fragile.
seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ products, drafts, test buyers and carts were deleted by id. acct1 store couriers were restored to their original value ([]). Admin pricing, home sections and popular pins were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported (pytest.ini uses xdist loadscope). Publish now requires weight_grams>0. The cargo test adds 'indahcargo' to acct1's store and restores it directly in the DB. pgs-official has couriers pickup/jne/jnt/sicepat and no cargo, so pe-ship-cargo is disabled there. UI login: fetch /api/auth/login and set localStorage 'pgs_auth_token'. Creating a draft via API and opening /product-editor/new?draft=ID avoids photo uploads. The publish confirm and success dialogs both use confirm-ok.
rca_of_issue: All 3 phase-1 bugs are verified fixed. (1) _load_cart_detailed skips products with status inactive, so they leave both cart and checkout. (2) variantText has no line-through. (3) get_for_edit maps an imported subcategory-as-category to its parent and subcategory.
